item.title: Nagasaki Night View from Mount Inasa — Guide
item.description: Nagasaki’s night view is celebrated as one of the ‘top three night views of Japan’, and the finest place to see it is the observation deck atop Mount Inasa (Inasayama), which rises 333 metres directly behind the city. Because Nagasaki is built around a harbour and up steep surrounding slopes, the lights of homes, streets and ships spill down the hillsides and ring the dark water like a giant jewel box or, as locals say, a ‘ten-million-dollar’ panorama.
